text: 金十数据8月5日讯，国家补贴叠加地方扩补政策落地，恰逢暑期消费旺季，广西家电市场迎来新一轮消费热潮。走访中发现，以旧换新政策持续加力，智能家电加速走进千家万户，消费升级态势明显。今年以来，广西消费品以旧换新累计补贴数码和智能产品206.1万台、汽车9.5万辆、家电255.3万台，补贴资金29.6亿元，拉动商品销售额267亿元。其中，县域参与主体占比达45.2%，农村地区享受补贴金额占比达37.1%，乡村消费潜力正在加速释放。北京工商大学商业经济研究所所长洪涛表示，以旧换新在政策持续托底的基础上，升级为“需求+体验”双轮驱动。国家、地方、企业构建起三重补贴
text_en: Jin10 Data, August 5: With national subsidies combined with local expansion policies taking effect, coinciding with the summer consumption peak season, Guangxi's home appliance market is experiencing a new round of consumption boom. Surveys found that the trade-in policy continues to be strengthened, smart home appliances are increasingly entering households, and the consumption upgrade trend is evident. Since the beginning of this year, Guangxi's consumer goods trade-in program has subsidized a cumulative 2.061 million digital and smart products, 95,000 vehicles, and 2.553 million home appliances, with subsidy funds of 2.96 billion yuan, driving merchandise sales of 26.7 billion yuan. Among these, county-level participants account for 45.2%, and rural areas account for 37.1% of subsidy amounts, with rural consumption potential rapidly being released. Hong Tao, director of the Commercial Economics Research Institute at Beijing Technology and Business University, stated that trade-in has upgraded to a "demand + experience" dual-driver model based on continued policy support.
